services.title: Get or renew a kebele resident ID
services.summary: A kebele resident ID shows you live in Batu. You need it for many city services. Enrol for the Fayda national digital ID at the same visit.
services.who: Residents aged 18 and over who live in a Batu kebele.
documents: Your old ID card, if renewing
A letter from your kebele or a witness from your block, for first-time applicants
Your Fayda number, if you have one
steps: Go to your kebele office with your documents.
Fill in the application form at the desk.
Pay the fee and keep the receipt.
Collect your ID when you are told it is ready.

services.title: Register a birth
services.summary: Register a baby's birth and get a birth certificate. Registration is free within 90 days of the birth.
services.who: Parents or guardians of a child born in Batu.
documents: Birth notification from the hospital or health centre
steps: Go to the Civil Registration desk at your kebele within 90 days.
Give the birth notification and parents' IDs.
Check the details on the record before you sign.
Collect the birth certificate.

fee.note: Free within 90 days; sample late fee applies after

services.title: Register a marriage
services.summary: Register a civil, religious or customary marriage and get a marriage certificate.
services.who: Couples married in Batu, or couples where one partner lives in Batu.
documents: Two witnesses for each partner, with their IDs
Two passport photos of each partner
Religious or customary marriage document, if you married that way
steps: Both partners and the witnesses go to the Civil Registration desk.
Fill in the marriage registration form.
Sign the register.
Collect the certificate.

services.title: Register a death
services.summary: Register a death and get a death certificate, needed for inheritance and pensions.
services.who: A relative or the person who reported the death.
documents: Death notification from the health facility, or a kebele confirmation
The ID of the person who died, if available
steps: Go to the Civil Registration desk within 30 days.
Give the notification and IDs.
Collect the death certificate.

services.title: Get a residence or support letter
services.summary: A letter confirming where you live, often asked for by banks, schools and employers.
services.who: Residents with a kebele resident ID.
documents: The name of the organisation that asked for the letter
steps: Request the letter online or at your kebele.
Pay the fee.
Collect the stamped letter.

services.title: Get a certificate of unmarried status
services.summary: A certificate stating you are not married, often needed for marriage abroad or some jobs.
services.who: Residents aged 18 and over.
steps: Apply at the Civil Registration desk.
Your witnesses sign a statement.
Pay the fee and collect the certificate.

services.title: Apply for a building permit
services.summary: You need a permit before you build, extend or change a building in Batu.
services.who: Land holders who plan to build, extend or renovate.
documents: Site plan from the land office
Architectural and structural drawings stamped by a licensed professional
Proof that land lease or land-use rent is paid up
steps: Check your plot's permitted use and height with the land office.
Submit the drawings and documents.
Engineers review the drawings and may ask for changes.
Pay the permit fee.
Collect the permit and display it on site.

fee.note: Sample base fee; the real fee depends on floor area

services.title: Pay land lease or land-use rent
services.summary: Pay your yearly land lease instalment or urban land-use rent using your lease reference number.
services.who: Holders of urban land under lease or old possession.
documents: Your lease or land reference number
steps: Find your reference number on your lease contract or last receipt.
Pay online with Telebirr or at the finance office.
Keep the receipt; it proves you are up to date.

fee.note: Amount depends on your lease contract

services.title: Transfer a property title
services.summary: Register a sale, gift or inheritance of land or a house in Batu.
services.who: Buyers, sellers, heirs and their legal representatives.
documents: Sale contract authenticated by the documents authority, or a court inheritance decision
Proof that lease, rent and taxes are paid
Tax clearance from the revenue office
steps: Get the property valued and pay the transfer tax.
Submit the documents to the land office.
The office checks the records and the boundaries.
Pay the registration fee.
Collect the new certificate.

fee.note: Sample registration fee, plus taxes set by the revenue office

services.title: Get a site plan or a copy of your land map
services.summary: A site plan shows your plot's boundaries and permitted use. You need it for permits and bank loans.
services.who: Land holders.
steps: Request the plan at the land office.
Pay the fee.
Collect the printed, stamped plan.

services.title: Get or renew a trade licence
services.summary: Register a new business or renew your trade licence. Many licences can be handled online through the national eTrade system.
services.who: Anyone starting or running a business in Batu.
documents: Your ID or company registration documents
Lease or rental agreement for the business premises
steps: Check the business category with the trade office.
Apply online through eTrade or at the trade office.
Pay the licence fee.
Collect or print your licence and display it.

fee.note: Sample fee; depends on the business category

services.title: Get a sign or billboard permit
services.summary: Signs, banners and billboards in public view need a permit.
services.who: Businesses and organisations.
documents: Drawing of the sign with size and location
Owner's permission, if on someone else's building
steps: Submit the design and location.
The office checks it against city rules.
Pay the yearly fee and display the permit number.

services.title: Rent a market stall
services.summary: Apply for a stall at a city market, or pay your stall rent.
services.who: Traders, with priority for youth and women enterprises in some markets.
documents: Trade licence, or registration as a micro or small enterprise
steps: Apply when stalls are announced on the Notices page.
Stalls are allocated by lottery or by queue, as announced.
Sign the rental agreement and pay monthly.

services.title: Buy tender documents and bid
services.summary: See open city tenders, buy the bid documents and submit your bid before the deadline.
services.who: Registered suppliers and contractors.
documents: Bid security, as stated in the tender
steps: Find the tender on the Tenders page.
Pay the non-refundable document fee.
Download the bid documents.
Submit your sealed bid to the finance office before the deadline.

fee.note: Sample document fee; each tender states its own

services.title: Apply for a city job
services.summary: See vacancies in city offices and apply.
services.who: Job seekers who meet the requirements in each vacancy.
steps: Find the vacancy on the Vacancies list.
Apply before the deadline.
Shortlisted candidates are called for an exam and interview.

services.title: Get a new water connection
services.summary: Apply for a piped water connection to your house or business.
services.who: Property holders and tenants with the owner's consent.
documents: Land holding certificate or lease contract
steps: Apply at the Batu Water Supply and Sewerage Service.
A technician visits to estimate the cost.
Pay the connection fee.
The connection is installed and a meter is fitted.

fee.note: Sample; depends on distance to the main line

services.title: Waste collection and sanitation
services.summary: Find your waste collection day, pay the sanitation fee, or report a missed collection.
services.who: Households and businesses.
steps: Check your kebele's collection day on the Find my kebele page.
Put waste out on the collection day only.
Report missed collections or illegal dumping through Report a problem.

services.title: Report a problem in the city
services.summary: Tell the city about a broken street light, a blocked drain, a pothole, a water leak or illegal dumping. You get a tracking number.
services.who: Anyone in Batu.
documents: A photo helps, but is not required
steps: Choose the type of problem.
Describe where it is, using a landmark.
Add a photo if you can.
Keep the tracking number to follow progress.
services.time: First response within 3 working days (sample target)

services.title: Make a complaint about a city service
services.summary: If a service was slow, unfair or asked for money it should not, you can complain. Complaints go to the good governance unit and get a reference number.
services.who: Anyone who used a city service.
documents: Any receipt, letter or reference number you have
steps: Describe what happened, when and in which office.
Submit online or at the complaints desk.
Get a reference number and a response date.
If you are not satisfied, you can take it to the Ethiopian Institution of the Ombudsman.

services.title: Enrol a child in a public school
services.summary: Register your child for kindergarten, primary or secondary school.
services.who: Parents and guardians.
documents: Previous school report card, when changing schools
steps: Check the school nearest to you with the education office.
Register at the school during the enrolment period, usually Hamle to Nehase (July to August).
Bring the documents to the school.

services.title: Find a health centre and vaccination days
services.summary: Find Batu Hospital and the health centres, their hours, and the days for child vaccination and antenatal care.
services.who: Everyone.
documents: Your health card or community-based health insurance card, if you have one
steps: In an emergency call 907 for an ambulance.
For routine care, go to the health centre for your kebele.
Bring your insurance card to avoid fees.
services.time: Open daily; emergency 24 hours at the hospital (sample)

services.title: Book a boat trip on Lake Dambal
services.summary: Book a boat to see pelicans and hippos, or a trip to Tulu Gudo island and its monastery, with a licensed boat association.
services.who: Visitors and residents.
steps: Choose the trip and the date.
Pay online or at the jetty.
Show your ticket code at the jetty.
Wear the life jacket the boat provides.

fee.note: Sample price for the bird and hippo trip; Tulu Gudo trips cost more

services.time: Bird trip about 1 hour; Tulu Gudo about 5 hours

services.title: Book a hall or sports field
services.summary: Book a city hall, meeting room or sports field for an event.
services.who: Residents, schools, clubs and organisations.
documents: Description of the event and expected number of people
steps: Choose the venue and date.
Submit the request.
Pay when the booking is confirmed.

services.title: Get a permit for a public event
services.summary: Public events, concerts and gatherings in public spaces need a permit and a safety plan.
services.who: Organisers of public events.
documents: Event plan with date, place and expected crowd
steps: Apply at least 10 working days before the event.
Peace and security reviews the safety plan.
Collect the permit.

services.title: Apply for investment land
services.summary: Apply for land for hotels, lodges, agro-processing and other investment. Lakeside lodge plots have been offered to serious investors.
services.who: Investors with a registered business and a project proposal.
steps: Talk to the investment office about available plots.
Submit the proposal.
The investment committee reviews it.
Sign the lease agreement and start within the agreed time.

fee.note: Lease price set by tender or allocation
